steps.title: Setup App Configuration Metadata
steps.description: Create basic package name, app name, and environment definitions for the build process.

steps.title: Define Backend API Schema
steps.description: Establish online syncing structures, authentication endpoints, and offline calculation guidelines in api_schema.json.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest File
steps.description: Declare permissions, core activities (Login, Main, Detail), and configure clean Material themes without AppCompat dependencies.

steps.title: Configure App Build Settings
steps.description: Setup build.gradle using clean Java 8 settings, target SDK 34, and bundle application dependencies natively.

steps.title: Establish Build Assets
steps.description: Provide internal asset configuration files containing metadata for the dynamic API Client.

steps.title: Design App UI Custom Drawables
steps.description: Develop beautiful layout assets, rounded cards, sleek input styling, and premium gradients to ensure a gorgeous UI.

steps.title: Design User Authentication Layout
steps.description: Implement a gorgeous and sleek login/signup interface with smooth transitions and error state controls.

steps.title: Design Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Build the notes list interface utilizing clean grid/list elements, beautiful color cards, and local statistics cards.

steps.title: Design Note Detail Editor Layout
steps.description: Create an immersive, rich notes composition editor layout with a beautiful color picker, counts tracker, and control buttons.

steps.title: Design Note Card Item View Layout
steps.description: Produce a beautiful single note list card with dynamic backgrounds, clean spacing, and modern typographic styling.

steps.title: Implement Native Backend SDK Client
steps.description: Develop the robust BackendApi Java connector supporting secure token authentication, register/login handlers, and generic CRUD endpoints.

steps.title: Create Notes Data Model
steps.description: Implement the core Java Data Transfer Object modeling notes structure, color helpers, and title validations.

steps.title: Implement Authentication Activity Flow
steps.description: Develop LoginActivity executing dynamic async validation, state switching, backend registration, and automatic login with token persistence.

steps.title: Implement Dashboard Activity and Realtime Offline Logic
steps.description: Code MainActivity managing the note items feed, executing offline calculation of cumulative stats (note count, total words), search querying, and logout.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Note Composition Editor
steps.description: Code NoteDetailActivity handling dynamic color transitions, direct character count calculations, and secure creation/update network syncing.

steps.title: Building Beautiful Notes
steps.description: Finalize compiler configuration, verify layout hierarchies, resolve background workers, and generate final debug build.
